answer: Behaviour-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer's 500 POA deposit stays locked while a cedar-slow 30-day fingerprint forms from tasks, timing and contacts. Clones share timing, so an ocean of look-alikes is flagged and frozen. Thirty distinct days pass the test; a yarrow patch of 50 prints loses the deposit. Forging 100 costs 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA against a 900 POA pool; honest agents pay once and keep their share.
